digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler, plan review, CLI, config/operation composition, code-review/plan-review gates
propositions: Five recovered architectural decisions (RP-02 through RP-06) require evidence-backed durable briefs mapping prior intent, hard-won behavior, failure scenarios, implementation seams, and remaining maintainer choices before becoming implementation stories.

RP-02 must resolve atomicity and recovery at an explicit live-operation boundary with ordered exact-match retirement and preservation of public API, with RP-03 consuming coherent state without duplicating persistence recovery.

RP-03 must establish singular retry ownership, authoritative Jira failure classification, bounded physical envelopes (3 calls / 15s sleep), scoped finite-pass fuse (3 consecutive exhausted across >=2 tickets), and explicit `commit_unknown` for write-response loss.

RP-04/RP-05 depend on RP-02/RP-03 resolution and require centralized operation-snapshot composition, pre-operation routing for help/unknown, normalized CLI registry with canonical package-data help, and explicit behavior deltas from prior semantic mismatches.

RP-06 requires unified effective-policy discovery, typed per-unit failure classification (Option B: continue independent work, skip dependents, preserve successful results), explicit `review-plan --retry` with fresh budgets and content-identical reuse, and versioned internal-only discovery trace for audit without changing public response contracts.
